meta.name: timeline-report
meta.description: Generate a "Journey Into [Project]" narrative report analyzing a project's entire development history from claude-mem's timeline. Use when asked for a timeline report, project history analysis, development journey, or full project report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目从起步到现在的开发历程整理成一篇叙事报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想回顾项目从零到现在的完整开发历程并写成一份报告
copy.tagline_en: Turn a project's development history into a narrative report
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to retell a project's full development journey as a report

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会读取 claude-mem 记录的项目时间线,分析从最初提交到最新的完整开发历程,产出一份《Journey Into [项目名]》叙事报告,并保存为 markdown 文件。
howto.when: 当你要求写时间线报告、项目历史分析、开发历程回顾,或提到「Journey into [项目]」等时触发。前提是 claude-mem worker 正在运行,且该项目已有观测记录。

say.text: 帮我为 tokyo 项目写一份时间线报告
say.note: 会先拉取时间线并估算 token 量,再等你确认

say.text: 分析一下这个项目的完整开发历史
say.note: 未指定项目时,用当前目录名作为数据源

say.text: 写一份 Journey Into 报告,存到 ./history.md

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads the project timeline recorded by claude-mem, analyzes the full development history from the first commit to the latest, and writes a "Journey Into [Project]" narrative report saved as a markdown file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a timeline report, project history analysis, a development journey, or "Journey into [project]". Requires the claude-mem worker running and recorded observations for the project.

say_en.text: Write a timeline report for the tokyo project
say_en.note: fetches the timeline and estimates token cost first

say_en.text: Analyze the full development history of this project
say_en.note: uses the current directory name as the project

say_en.text: Write a Journey Into report and save it to ./history.md
say_en.note: report is saved to the path you give
